decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown in drawing ISLE 04, the street frontage of the development shall comply with drawing ISLE 02A (received 1 October 2007 - omitting the proposed ramp and handrail detail) and the details given in drawing ISLE 04 shall be used solely for the purpose of implementing the details of the air conditioning equipment and satellite dish hereby approved.

Condition : 4 - The forecourt of the premises shall be modified by means of a ramp between the shopfront and the existing concrete roadway two metres to the north of the shopfront not exceeding a gradient of 1:12 to provide a level threshold, similar to the existing ramp to the front door of the premises, for the full width of the shopfront hereby approved,.  The eastern and western sides of the ramp shall be reduced to the adjoining ground level immediately to the east and west in a gradual manner so as to avoid the creation of a trip hazard.
description: Installation of new shopfront incorporating disabled access ramp. Installation of air conditioning condenser units and two satellite dishes to rear of premises.
